title: Preserve one searchable universe during change and failure
description: Inject a model rollout, lagging replica, or selective ANN query. Toggle the guard that keeps results compatible, fresh enough, and complete enough for the caller.

scenarios.label: A new embedding model is 35% backfilled
scenarios.detail: Old and new vectors have the same dimensions but represent meaning in different learned spaces.

scenarios.label: The search replica is behind the primary
scenarios.detail: Recent inserts and deletions are committed on the primary while replay lags by 45 seconds.

scenarios.label: A tenant filter matches five percent of rows
scenarios.detail: The initial ANN scan visits 40 candidates but the caller requires ten permitted results.
